[[Rocky Ground]] is an [[environment effect]] strongly suspected to cause players to leave their [[Junundu]]s if they are currently in one. This effect also displays a message which inform the player that Junundus cannot travel through the rocky terrain. The Junundu will otherwise automatically release the character controlling it, as if the skill [[Leave Junundu]] was used.
==Notes==
{{anomaly|[[Junundu Tunnel]] is not removed when walking on rocky ground, allowing players to benefit from the 66% speed boost for a moment.}}
